name: My Clinic
source: Sampled from official My Clinic decks (HR.pptx company template; Operations & My Care Structure.pptx). Confirm with Marketing (decision D11).
imagery_style: Clean flat vector illustration in the My Clinic palette: navy outlines and shapes, white space, one module colour as highlight, light blue-grey secondary shapes, no gradients, no text, no logos. Diagrams are own SVG with real text. Software screenshots from test accounts only.

voice.persona: an experienced colleague coaching a new team member in their first week

do: Place the supplied logo files exactly; navy on light, white on navy
One idea per screen; keywords on screen, explanation in narration
Navy for structure and the assigned module colour for highlights; Operations & My Care uses responsible magenta as its module colour, while other modules reserve magenta for warnings and key numbers
Real HTML text; images contain no text
Feedback shown with icon, words and colour
dont: Never AI-generate or redraw the logo or the words My Clinic
No logo on teal, purple, magenta, burgundy or photos
No small white text on teal; no small teal text on white (use #006E78)
No watermark behind questions or body text
No real patient or staff data; no third-party watermarks
